## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Amsterdam, Netherlands. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at Moco Museum / Amsterdam, Museum Square, Honthorststraat 20, 1071 DE Amsterdam, Netherlands. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The ticket to Moco Museum Amsterdam is included in this self-guided audio walking tour. Please note that an audio tour inside the museum is not provided within this bundle. You may redeem it at the museum.
>
> After you finish exploring Moco Museum, unpause the tour and walk on Museumplein, where contemporary art sets the tone, then continues to the Rijksmuseum for Dutch national treasures. From there, the route shifts to Melkweg, a former industrial site turned cultural venue, before reaching the Anne Frank House on Prinsengracht. The journey carries on to the Royal Palace on Dam Square, pauses at Van Stapele Koekmakerij, then explores the medieval heart of the city at Oude Kerk and the Red Light Secrets Museum.
>
> The tour ends at the Rembrandt House Museum, where one of the Dutch Golden Age’s greatest artists once lived and worked. Along the way, the most memorable experiences include standing before bold modern works, passing from grand civic spaces to quiet canal houses, sensing the weight of wartime memory, tasting one of Amsterdam’s most talked-about cookies, and discovering how old churches, nightlife, and masterpieces coexist in a single city.
